description: Home affordability — How much house an income supports (offline): solves the maximum home price under lender debt-to-income guidelines (program=conventional 28/36 with PMI above 80% LTV, fha 31/43 with 1.75% upfront + 0.55% annual MIP and 3.5% minimum down, va 41% back-end with financed funding fee; or custom front=/back=), with the full monthly PITI breakdown, DTI ratios, cash to close and a +1% rate stress test. Pass price= to grade a specific home COMFORTABLE / AFFORDABLE / STRETCH / NOT AFFORDABLE. Inputs: income (gross annual) and rate (%); optional debts (monthly), down (amount) or down_pct, term (years, default 30), tax_rate (% of price/yr, default 1.0), insurance (annual $) or insurance_pct (default 0.35), hoa (monthly), pmi_rate, closing_pct. Estimate, not a loan offer. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_home_affordability
